description: Get a company's revenue rank positions within its industry (PKD), region (voivodeship), and all of Poland. Returns rows from company_financial_rankings — one row per scope (pkd_full, pkd_division, pkd_section, region, country). PKD scope keys of historical classifications are prefixed with the version: 'v2007:62.01.Z', 'v2004:50', 'v1997:74.84.B' (no prefix = PKD 2025). `benchmark`: the company compared with peers (median, quartiles, mean of revenue, profit, costs, assets) in its industry, region and city, as on the profile. Use for questions like: where does company X rank in Poland / its industry / its region, how does it compare with its industry?

krs.description: KRS number of the company in the Polish National Court Register (10 digits).

name.description: Company name, used when the KRS or NIP is not known.

nip.description: Polish company tax number (NIP) of the business, 10 digits.

scope_type.description: Optional. Filter to a single scope. Omit to get all scopes.
